import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization')
inputs = Path('/tmp/astra-pass70-inputs.json')
manifest = json.loads(inputs.read_text())
bindings = manifest['hashes'] | manifest['dependency_hashes']
for name, digest in bindings.items():
    data = (root / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    assert data.endswith(b'\n'), name
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in data.splitlines()), name
for review, sources in manifest['review_bindings'].items():
    text = (root / review).read_text()
    for source in sources:
        assert bindings[source] in text, (review, source)
commands = []
for argv in ([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'], ['git', 'diff', '--check'], [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py']):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
    commands.append({'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    assert result.returncode == 0, commands[-1]
receipt = {
    'checkpoint': 'Pass70',
    'parent_main': 'c11915b8ce83d98a4a6c859fce51e3ad4a1176da',
    'status': 'verified_local_pending_publication',
    **manifest,
    'checks': {'frozen_source_bindings': len(manifest['hashes']), 'dependency_bindings': len(manifest['dependency_hashes']), 'review_bindings': 'passed', 'newline_and_trailing_whitespace': 'passed'},
    'commands': commands,
    'root_verifier': {'argv': [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__))], 'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'input_source': inputs.read_text(), 'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256(inputs.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
    'mathematical_verification': 'Two independent hand reviews and root full reads. No mathematical program or replay; the retained prior control is used through the independently reviewed finite-cell reduction.',
    'scope': 'Uniform exact finite-cell equivalence, explicit conditional auxiliary failure height, and two restricted ideal-selection families. No unrestricted LRC resolution, general ideal selection or finite-M success.',
    'excluded': 'Active uniform carry-exclusion task and any draft it creates.',
    'failure_history': 'No integration verifier failures or mathematical reruns. One scope sentence in the selection author manuscript was corrected before independent review; all other author bytes were verified unchanged.',
}
(root / 'research/astra-pass70-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'checkpoint': 'Pass70', 'result': 'passed', 'source_bindings': len(manifest['hashes']), 'dependency_bindings': len(manifest['dependency_hashes']), 'commands': commands}, indent=2))
